at least two digits. Digits beyond that are kept only when they are significant, so `1.5` becomes `1.50`, `2` becomes `2.00`, and `0.25` stays `0.25`. An amount like 1.234 NEAR shows as `1.234` rather than being rounded, because the requirement that `parseNear(formatNear(x)) === x` for every input rules out hiding digits.

I did not run extra edge-case checks. A separate `bun` script was blocked by an approval prompt, so I checked the edge cases by hand instead: `0`, `1 NEAR`, `0.25 NEAR`, `1.234 NEAR`, `10^30`, `0.999…9 NEAR` (24 nines), and `1 NEAR + 1 yocto` all round-trip correctly.
